profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Iru | Ex-Google | Distributed Systems, Platform Engineering, Security and Identity Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Twenty years building developer infrastructure, distributed systems, and platforms. Today I'm a Staff Software Engineer at Iru, working on the endpoint agent. Before that I spent five years at Google, most recently as backend tech lead for the certification platform for Google Meet hardware.
  
I've taken platforms from zero to production twice. At Google, an external-facing certification platform designed from inception through VP-approved, launched on a public google.com domain. Before that, a regulated patient-lending platform on Azure, taken from nothing to production within a year. Earlier I was technical lead for the Citrix Cloud Connector across 3,000+ enterprise deployments, work that produced patent US10365910B2.
  
The thread through all of it is making engineering faster and safer. Hermetic test environments, build systems, CI/CD and GitOps delivery, infrastructure as code, observability and on-call ownership, and authorization and identity design. I use AI coding tools and agents daily and hold what they produce to deterministic verification before it ships.
  
Based in South Florida, working fully remote.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Iru is the AI-powered security & IT platform used by the world’s fastest-growing companies to secure their users, apps, and devices. Built for the AI era, Iru unifies identity & access, endpoint security & management, and compliance automation; collapsing the stack and giving IT & security time and control back.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend tech lead for the testing and certification platform for Google Meet hardware, an external-facing product used by third-party OEM partners.

- Co-designed the platform from inception as one of three tech leads, replacing a manual certification process tracked in a single spreadsheet. Owned infrastructure architecture, end-to-end authorization and security design, Google Workspace integration, and external edge routing, with the PRD, design doc, and threat model approved at VP level.
- Delivered the platform scaffold single-handedly in roughly five months ahead of team ramp-up, then launched externally in 2026 on a public google.com domain after clearing Google's security and edge review, with a separate regional regulatory review covering the data the platform retains.
- Built the platform's certification workflow in-house on event-driven async processing over internal pub/sub, task queues, and scheduling, backed by Spanner-backed queues, carrying a certification through its stages across separate corporate entities.
- Owned full-stack features end to end, database to frontend, and served as primary on-call responder for the platform's production environments. Java and Kotlin backend services, TypeScript UI, protobuf service design across the backend.
- Earlier (2021 to 2024): engineering productivity for Google's telephony products, including Google Voice. Built hermetic VoIP test environments carrying SIP signaling over TLS through an edge TCP proxy, and cut test flakiness from over 50% to around 2% against a 5% target, with median presubmit runs 40% faster. The flakiness work earned an engineering health award, and the hermetic environment work earned promotion to Senior. 20% contributor on the internal VS Code maintainers team.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technical Leadership · Software Design · Technical Project Leadership

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Senior engineer on a two-person cloud architecture team stood up inside an all on-premise company to prove cloud native. The platform financed medical procedures directly to patients, operating under financial regulation and HIPAA at the same time.

- Architected an event-driven customer-financing platform on Azure and took it from nothing to production within a year, then evolved it from serverless Functions to Kubernetes with Knative and Istio for ingress and service mesh, with monitoring and dashboards converged on Prometheus and Grafana.
- Set cloud standards and technical direction across the engineering portfolio and built the delivery platform every product team shipped through, on Terraform and Helm for infrastructure as code, Azure DevOps YAML pipelines with a self-hosted agent pool, and GitOps continuous delivery on Argo CD, later standardized on Flux. Owned the platform's delegated DNS zone in Azure, including the SPF and DKIM records behind outbound customer email.
- Built the nightly settlement pipeline paying providers, batching disbursements into NACHA files composed by a Go microservice, orchestrated on Azure Durable Functions with stage-level retry behind event queues so a failed stage recovered on its own while the rest of the run continued.
- Built the customer-facing site front to back in React and TypeScript, and a secure-by-default CI pipeline that cleared external audits and penetration tests with no findings above low severity. Ran the platform's certificate estate on DigiCert rather than the cloud provider's default, with a certificate per domain to contain compromise, scripted renewal and rotation, and private keys held in a key vault separate from application secrets.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Software Design · Technical Project Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for the Citrix Cloud Connector, the hybrid cloud enablement service running on 3,000+ enterprise deployments.

- Cut manual administrator intervention roughly 90% by rebuilding an update path that failed over 40% of the time into a zero-touch one, cataloging the failure modes and coding their remediation server-side. Patent US10365910B2 came out of this work.
- Led the connector's cryptographic identity lifecycle: keypair generation at install, OAuth-bootstrapped key registration, centrally orchestrated rotation staged per customer per region, and backend revocation with self-removal.
- Owned the reverse tunnel giving cloud services addressable access to on-premise systems behind customer firewalls, dialing out from the customer network with WebSocket upgrade for bidirectional traffic on an in-house implementation that predated the common libraries.
- Worked across the identity layer that let enterprise customers bring their own directory, resolving logins against Azure AD or routing down to on-premise Active Directory over LDAP, and built delegated administration on top of it. Delivered under FedRAMP authorization for US government cloud.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Platform engineering for TradeStation's live retail trading platform across equities, forex, and futures.

- Built the crash reporting pipeline that classified and routed production crashes to their owning teams, cutting mean time to resolution roughly 50%.
- Overhauled the build system with gated check-ins and self-built dependency graph analysis, taking per-change verification from hours to minutes and speeding incremental builds roughly 35%.
- Worked across the compiler of TradeStation's proprietary trading language, including parsing, code generation, multithreading, and the visual designer, in C++ and x86 assembly.
- Built a record and playback framework replacing live market data servers for reproducible testing, and the company-wide structured logging framework, centralizing logs on Elasticsearch with ETW for performance instrumentation.

positions.title: Sr E-Commerce Developer
positions.description: Modernized legacy e-commerce platforms into an n-tier service architecture with OData, REST, and SOAP services for third-party integrators, built mobile-adaptive frontends, and eliminated critical database latency through index and query optimization.

positions.description: Led development of POS, ticketing, and player tracking systems for the cruise industry, including fingerprint-based crew sign-on.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: .NET development for document management solutions and data-driven web applications.

patents.title: Systems and methods for uninstalling or upgrading software if package cache is removed or corrupted
patents.description: This provides a mechanism for an auto update system to repair itself on subsequent updates if the original package cache is lost or corrupted.
